content: Stockfish: latest 17.1 (2025-03-30); Stockfish 18 also referenced on download page. Install on Apple Silicon via 'brew install stockfish' (path /opt/homebrew/opt/stockfish) or direct macOS-m1-apple-silicon binary from stockfishchess.org/download/macos. Used both as the label generator (position eval) for supervised NNUE data and as gauntlet/sparring opponent.
